source_statement: Let ABC be an acute triangle. Let D, E, and F be the feet of altitudes from A, B, and C to sides BC, CA, and AB, respectively, and let Q be the foot of altitude from A to line EF . Given that AQ = 20, BC = 15, and AD = 24, compute the perimeter of triangle DEF .

clause_ledger.source: acute triangle ABC; BC=15 and AD=24
clause_ledger.dsl: B,C are fixed on the x-axis, A=(u,24), and all three acute-angle guards are retained
D is the direct foot on BC; E and F use FootOfPerpendicular to CA and AB

clause_ledger.source: Q foot of altitude from A to EF and AQ=20

clause_ledger.dsl: sum of the three source side distances
